description: This file defines a set of API routes related to futures trading data, including historical prices, futures curve, instruments, and info. It uses a router to register commands with associated metadata and handlers.

methods.name: OBBject instruments( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )

methods.name: OBBject info( cc: CommandContext, provider_choices: ProviderChoices, standard_params: StandardParams, extra_params: ExtraParams, )
